scientific_review.design_equivalence: Active design equals the original design after removing run_id; only run_id metadata differs. Original design bytes remain available at the r1 parent path with the original SHA-256.
scientific_review.arms: K4 uses rollout 256, gamma 0.995, lambda 0.95, effective minibatch 512. K1 uses rollout 1024, fourth-root gamma/lambda, effective minibatch 2048 via weighted 512 microbatches. Both keep entropy coefficient 0.01.
scientific_review.frame_contract: Both arms target 11,796,480 actual gameplay frames, retain the final full vector step and valid partial rows, exclude startup frames, and bound paired frame-count difference to 256.
scientific_review.estimand_and_limit: One paired training trajectory. Primary is the difference between separately sorted marginal Q1 distributions under sampled repeat1 inference, with a shared D9 seed-cluster bootstrap (2,000 draws; seed 202610290503). Evaluation uncertainty is conditional on this pair; it does not estimate training-replica variance. No automatic promotion.
scientific_review.objective_limit: K1 fourth-root gamma/lambda matches K4 decay across four-frame decision boundaries. K4 still aggregates within-call rewards without internal per-frame discounting; interpret as the registered matched-frame recipe bundle, not exact per-frame objective equivalence.
scientific_review.training_streams: Pair seed remains 202610290501 and same accepted uniform512 training-only pool. Handoff retains exact authorization, zero-worker failure-disposition, and old lease-release pins. No replacement stream or seed is specified.
scientific_review.evaluation: D9 reservation remains 1,024 seeds, 6,144 games, zero recorded overlap in its bounded history scope, and outcomes_read=false. This review did not read outcomes.
